Deoxynivalenol
Deoxynivalenol (DON) is a mycotoxin primarily produced by Fusarium fungi, occurring predominantly in cereal grains. The TDI of
1 mg/kg bw/day was established for DON by JECFA and EFSA, based on reduced body weight gain in mice with exposure to the sum
